mapped_elevator.photo_reference: ALP-PROM photo_1.jpg, likely grey third corpus; outline/height mapped, rib and opening counts inferred

foundation_alignment.assumption: Third elevator uses the median foundation datum of the two existing 40 m elevators. Ground beneath its footprint is levelled with a 12 m smooth transition so a DSM roof bump cannot double the building height. No mapped existing building, track or pit geometry is changed.

surface_geometry_method: Exact native GROUND loop-triangle clipping, per-triangle planar Z + 28 mm
accuracy: Factory building footprints and industrial land-use polygons are OSM-derived. Working aprons (11.5 m) and compacted yards (15-29 m) are inferred, not surveyed. Loading platforms/canopies align with existing fictional v08 doors. The missing third elevator (way/395673029) is restored from source XML with its tagged 40 m height; its grey ribs/windows are photo-informed. Existing mapped walls/roofs and main/pit track meshes are untouched. Private service gates are separate from race protection.
